# Third-party provenance

Core.lean is an unmodified copy of ToshiDad/erdos-882/Erdos882.lean at commit 6ea233aed4b3efce92e2754177ef15c4085f8732, under Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE). Source: https://github.com/ToshiDad/erdos-882.

It formalizes the ELRSS99 lower-bound construction non-divisibility lemma. The source README credits proof architecture assisted by Claude, with Lean proof terms produced with Claude Code. This project makes no claim of authorship or first formalization for that core.
